title: Kalshi partners with iconic Major League Baseball brands
summary: Kalshi has announced exclusive, multi-year brand partnerships with the Braves, Red Sox, Dodgers, Padres, and Giants.
body_markdown:
Kalshi today announced it’s entering into exclusive, multi-year brand partnerships with five club teams: The Atlanta Braves, Boston Red Sox, Los Angeles Dodgers, San Diego Padres, and San Francisco Giants.


The collaborations will include in-stadium signage, plus social, online, radio, and fan activations. The Dodgers partnership, for instance, will include Kalshi-branded LED signage around Dodger Stadium, as well as grant the platform naming rights for the stadium’s Gold Glove Bar. Fans will have access to Kalshi-specific offers and exclusive on-site activations throughout the season in Centerfield Plaza.


Baseball markets on Kalshi have exploded in popularity over the last year: baseball-related trading volume is up 36x YoY.


“The idea is that fans are already engaging with their favorite teams on Kalshi, so it only makes sense to extend that fandom to some of the most beloved baseball teams in America,” said Adam Barrick, Head of Sports Partnerships at Kalshi.


Founded in 2018, Kalshi is the world’s next-generation financial exchange. Prediction markets provide accurate, real-time information on the likelihood of events, making people more informed about the future. As the first regulated exchange for events, Kalshi is credited with legalizing and establishing prediction markets as a financial asset class. It’s the leading safe and regulated platform, trusted by millions of people and a growing number of institutions in America.
